name: Zero Based Budget
description: Builds a zero-based budget where every dollar of income is assigned to a specific spending, saving, or debt category so that income minus all allocations equals exactly zero. Produces a fully populated allocation table with assignment rationale for each category. Use when the user asks about zero-based budgeting, wants to assign every dollar a job, or wants maximum control over their monthly spending. Do NOT use for quick percentage-based budgets (use fifty-thirty-twenty-budget), investment allocation, or business budgeting.
